question: Have I concealed a mortal sin in confession? (Which one?)
Have I received Holy Communion or another sacrament while in mortal sin?
Have I been religiously indifferent?
Have I sinned by superstition, fortune-telling, card reading, spiritism, magic, astrology, the use of horoscopes, talismans, homeopathy and the like?
Have I been willingly distracted at prayer?
Have I on the whole given more attention in my life to the world than to God, to the body than to the soul, to possessions than to spiritual things?
Have I taken God's name in vain?
Have I used abusive language and cursed?
Have I through my own fault missed Holy Mass on a Sunday or a holy day of obligation?
Have I been disrespectful to my mother, my father, my teachers or my superiors?
Have we as spouses failed to live in love, harmony and Christian decency?
Have I harmed my health by intemperance? (e.g. in food, drink, smoking, alcohol, drugs, gambling, otherwise....)
Have I wasted time? (e.g. at the computer, watching television...)
Have I lived in hatred and enmity with my neighbours?
Have I been prone to anger?
Have I avoided helping my neighbour in his real need?
Have I taken pleasure in impure thoughts and images?
Have I willingly aroused impure images and feelings? (e.g. by reading immoral books, listening to impure talk, through pornography, the internet, contacts on social networks, etc.)
Have I committed impure acts upon myself? (sinful touches, completed self-abuse)
Have I committed impure acts with other persons?
Have I had illicit desire for another's property?
Have I taken another's property secretly, by theft or by robbery? (From whom, what and where?)
Have I failed to fulfil the duties agreed with my employer?
Have I lied to my neighbour's harm?
Have I spoken needlessly of my neighbour's faults? (detraction)
Have I failed to go to confession at least once a year?
Have I incited another to sin?
Have I been proud / self-satisfied? (about what?)
Have I been envious, or glad at another's misfortune?
Have I given myself to spiritual and bodily sloth?
